Legend of the White Dragon Plot : After three years of forced hiding as a fugitive, Erik Reed—a former superhero known as the White Dragon—returns to the city he swore to protect. His goal: to clear his name and reunite with the family he keeps secret. Only one thing stands in his way: the mysterious Dragon Prime, who will stop at nothing to enact his revenge on the White Dragon.

Legend of the White Dragon is an upcoming American superhero film directed by Sean and Aaron Schoenke. The film reunites Power Rangers actors Jason David Frank, Jason Faunt, Cerina Vincent and Ciara Hanna. It also stars Schoenke, David Ramsey, Andrew Bachelor, Mark Dacascos, and Michael Madsen. The story, set three years after a tragic battle, sees Erik Reed / the White Dragon (Frank) return to his city to protect his wife and daughter from a new threat.
